showcase.site.aboutModels.en: 3D furniture and lights for your floor plans, by room and by brand.
showcase.site.aboutModels.context: Under the title of the 3D furniture page.

showcase.site.aboutPartials.en: Pieces that widget makers share for their own widgets, such as an alarm that pulses when it goes off.
showcase.site.aboutPartials.context: Under the title of the Partials page.

showcase.site.aboutThemes.en: Colours, type and the feel of every tile at once. Each is shown on real tiles.
showcase.site.aboutThemes.context: Under the title of the Themes page.

showcase.site.aboutWidgets.en: Tiles for your dashboards. Each one is drawn here on a demo home, as it would look on yours.
showcase.site.aboutWidgets.context: Under the title of the Widgets page.

showcase.site.allModels.context: Link at the end of a front page row.

showcase.site.allResults.en: {count, plural, one {See the result for “{query}”} other {All # results for “{query}”}}
showcase.site.allResults.context: Last line of the results under the search box: opens a page with all of them.

params.query: What was typed in the search box.

showcase.site.allThemes.context: Link at the end of a front page row.

showcase.site.allWidgets.context: Link at the end of a front page row.

showcase.site.brand.context: Fact on a 3D furniture item’s page.

showcase.site.brandPieces.context: Beside a brand on the brands page: how many pieces of 3D furniture it has.

showcase.site.brands.context: Navigation: 3D furniture by brand (IKEA, Philips Hue…).

showcase.site.brandsLink.context: Link on the 3D furniture page to the brands page.

showcase.site.breadcrumb.context: Screen reader label of the link back to the kind’s page.

showcase.site.by.context: Under a featured item: who made it. {maker} is their name.

params.maker: The maker’s display name, such as “Night Owl”.

showcase.site.byLinked.context: Under an item’s name on its page: who made it, the name a link to their page.

params.name: The maker’s display name, such as “Night Owl”.

showcase.site.byTiledash.context: Front page row title: items made by Tiledash itself.

showcase.site.byTiledashLead.en: Made and kept up to date by the people who build Tiledash.

showcase.site.colMaker.context: Table column header: who published it.

showcase.site.colUpdated.context: Table column header: when its last version came out.

showcase.site.count.context: How many items a list page shows.

showcase.site.demoNote.en: On a demo home, with made-up readings
showcase.site.demoNote.context: Beside the size switch under a widget’s preview.

showcase.site.everythingByTiledash.context: Link at the end of the By Tiledash row: Tiledash’s maker page.

showcase.site.featured.context: Screen reader label of the featured items at the top.

showcase.site.filterFor.context: Heading above the tags to filter a list page by (energy, lights, climate…).

showcase.site.filterLabel.context: Screen reader label of the filters.

showcase.site.footerName.context: The site’s name in the footer of every page.

showcase.site.headline.en: Widgets, themes and furniture for your Tiledash dashboard
showcase.site.headline.context: The front page’s title, beside the featured items drawn as a dashboard.

showcase.site.homeLabel.context: Screen reader label of the logo link in the top bar, which opens the front page.

showcase.site.install.context: Main button on an item’s page: opens the item in the Tiledash app to install it.

showcase.site.installNote.en: Opens it in Tiledash, where you log in with your Homey account. Free is enough.
showcase.site.installNote.context: Under the Install in Tiledash button.

showcase.site.kindsLabel.context: Screen reader label of the navigation with Widgets, Themes, 3D furniture, Partials.

showcase.site.languages.context: Fact on an item’s page: the languages it shows in.

showcase.site.loadingMore.context: Under a list page while the next page of items loads as you scroll.

showcase.site.makerInstalls.en: {installs} of {count, plural, one {the one thing} other {# things}} they made
showcase.site.makerInstalls.context: Under a maker: how many installs their items have. {installs} is like “2,310 installs”.

params.installs: How many installs, already written out, such as “2,310 installs”.

showcase.site.makerSince.context: Under a maker’s name on their page. {month} is like “March 2026”.

params.handle: The maker’s handle without @, such as “nightowl”.
params.month: A month and year, such as “March 2026”.

showcase.site.menu.context: Phone: opens the menu with the kinds.

showcase.site.menuNote.en: Free to try with your Homey. Installing happens in Tiledash.
showcase.site.menuNote.context: Under the phone menu’s Open Tiledash button.

showcase.site.modelNote.en: Drag to turn it round. In Tiledash you can see it in your own rooms.

showcase.site.models.context: Navigation: the page of all 3D furniture and lights for floor plans.

showcase.site.moreBy.context: Heading above more items by the same maker.

params.maker: The maker’s display name, such as “Night Owl”.

showcase.site.newest.context: Front page list title: items published lately.

showcase.site.noResults.context: Search results page when nothing matches.

params.query: What was typed in the search box.

showcase.site.noResultsHint.en: Search for a device or a room, like “thermostat” or “bedroom”, or look through:
showcase.site.noResultsHint.context: Under “Nothing matches”, before links to Widgets, Themes, 3D furniture and Partials.

showcase.site.notFoundText.en: It may have been taken down by its maker. Have a look at what’s there instead.

showcase.site.notFoundTitle.en: This isn’t in the community (any more)
showcase.site.notFoundTitle.context: Title when an item or maker doesn’t exist.

showcase.site.nothingFor.context: When the filters match nothing. {tags} is the chosen tags, like “energy and solar”.

showcase.site.nothingFound.en: Nothing called “{query}” yet. Try a device, like “thermostat”.
showcase.site.nothingFound.context: Under the search box when nothing matches.

params.query: What was typed in the search box.

showcase.site.official.context: Screen reader label of the mark beside Tiledash’s own name.

showcase.site.oneModel.context: The kind of one item, on a card where kinds mix.

showcase.site.onePartial.context: The kind of one item, on a card where kinds mix.

showcase.site.oneTheme.context: The kind of one item, on a card where kinds mix.

showcase.site.oneWidget.context: The kind of one item, on a card where kinds mix.

showcase.site.open.context: Screen reader label of an item’s picture, which opens its page.

params.title: The item’s name, such as “Big clock”.

showcase.site.openTiledash.context: Button in the top bar: opens the Tiledash app (logging in there if need be).

showcase.site.partials.context: Navigation: the page of all partials, pieces that makers use in their own widgets.

showcase.site.publishLink.context: Link to the guide’s page on publishing.

showcase.site.publishText.en: Share it from Tiledash’s Workshop. Anyone with Tiledash can install it.

showcase.site.publishTitle.en: Made something for your own dashboard?
showcase.site.publishTitle.context: Closing section of the front page.

showcase.site.publishYourOwn.context: Footer link to the guide on publishing.

showcase.site.publishedAgo.context: Under an item in the New list. {when} is a relative time like “3 days ago”.

params.maker: The maker’s display name, such as “Night Owl”.
params.when: A relative time, such as “3 days ago” or “today”.

showcase.site.resultsCount.context: Under the title of the search results page.

showcase.site.resultsFor.context: Title of the search results page.

params.query: What was typed in the search box.

showcase.site.resultsLabel.context: Screen reader label of the list of results under the search box.

showcase.site.searchLabel.context: Screen reader label of the search box.

showcase.site.searchOpen.context: Phone: the button that opens the search box.

showcase.site.searchPlaceholder.en: Search widgets, themes, furniture and makers
showcase.site.searchPlaceholder.context: Placeholder of the search box in the top bar.

showcase.site.showEverything.context: Clears the filters of a list page.

showcase.site.showOf.context: Screen reader label of a dot under a row you swipe through on a phone.

params.index: The dot’s place in the row, from 1.

showcase.site.siteName.context: Next to the Tiledash logo in the top bar of the community site: which part of Tiledash this is.

showcase.site.sizeLabel.context: Screen reader label of the size switch of a widget’s preview.

showcase.site.sortBy.context: Label before the sort order on a list page.

showcase.site.sortInstalls.context: Sort order: the most installed first.

showcase.site.sortUpdated.context: Sort order: the latest updated first.

showcase.site.themes.context: Navigation: the page of all themes.

showcase.site.topMakers.context: Front page section title: the makers whose items are installed most.

showcase.site.tryAgain.context: Button that loads the page again.

showcase.site.unreachable.en: The community can’t be reached right now. Try again in a minute.
showcase.site.unreachable.context: When the community’s server doesn’t answer.

showcase.site.updated.context: Front page list title: items that got a new version lately.

showcase.site.updatedAgo.context: Under an item in the Recently updated list. {when} is a relative time like “3 days ago”.

params.maker: The maker’s display name, such as “Night Owl”.
params.when: A relative time, such as “3 days ago” or “today”.

showcase.site.usedBy.context: Fact on an item’s page: how many installed it.

showcase.site.versionWhen.context: The latest version and when it came out, like “2.1.0, 3 days ago”.

params.when: A relative time, such as “3 days ago” or “today”.

showcase.site.view.context: Screen reader label of the view switch on a list page.

showcase.site.viewList.context: View switch: a table with a small picture per row.

showcase.site.viewSmall.context: View switch: small tiles, more per row.

showcase.site.widgets.context: Navigation: the page of all widgets.
